definition.description: Ariadi is the 3‑sphere S³ containing a properly embedded 1‑dimensional structure chosen from {Knot, Link, Braid}.

manifestation.description: The abstract topological space manifests differently across planes, with the complement providing resonant structure

default.name: T(19,2) torus knot
default.reason: Selected as MythOS default because its 19 crossings map to Cilang's 19 primitives, and its complement provides natural resonance harmonics

properties.alexander_polynomial: t¹⁸ - t¹⁷ + t¹⁶ - t¹⁵ + t¹⁴ - t¹³ + t¹² - t¹¹ + t¹⁰ - t⁹ + t⁸ - t⁷ + t⁶ - t⁵ + t⁴ - t³ + t² - t + 1

structure_encoding.description: Explicit planar diagram of T(19,2) as a list of 19 crossings, each a 4‑tuple of edge indices (1..38). The cyclic order is [a,b,c,d] meaning edges a→b and c→d cross, with over/under given by sign.
structure_encoding.format: Each crossing is [a,b,c,d] where edges a→b and c→d are the two strands. The cyclic order is a,b,c,d. Sign +1 indicates edge a→b is over c→d, sign -1 indicates under.

ariadi.constraint: Manifold is always S³. Structure's crossing number ≤ 19. For the default T(19,2), the structure_encoding provides the explicit embedding from which Cilang and Usepong are derived.

definition.description: Cilang nodes are the 19 crossing positions (or strands) of the chosen structure.

state_definition.applicability: States apply only to explicit nodes (0‑9a‑f).
state_definition.implicit_nodes: x, y, z are always in state 0 (eternal context).

cilang.constraint: The node set is invariant; connectivity may change based on the chosen structure.

usepong.role: The Grammar of Relationship and Dynamics

definition.description: Usepong defines adjacency between Cilang nodes, derived from the chosen structure.

base.description: The fundamental adjacency of the T(19,2) knot—a directed 19‑cycle visiting every node exactly once.

strata.description: Catalog of satellite families. Each stratum defines a weighted adjacency on the 19 nodes. Actual data is stored in `acu.data.satellites`.

families.name: Ur-Trefoil
families.description: Complete aggregation of all 86 trefoil satellites (001‑086).
families.best_for: Cosmic creation myths, meta‑canon establishment, universe source code, mathematical foundations.

families.name: Canonical Trefoil
families.description: Largest family (48 variants, 087‑134). Most mature, 'canonical' trefoil structure.
families.best_for: Epic narratives, heroic journeys, cosmic myths, foundational stories.

families.name: Emergent Trefoil
families.description: Medium family (18 variants, 135‑152). 'Emerging' structures with invariant hexagon at lower weights.
families.best_for: Coming‑of‑age stories, discovery‑focused narratives, exploration, first contact.

families.name: Philosophical Trefoil
families.description: Large family (36 variants, 153‑188). Exceptionally strong coherence.
families.best_for: Theological discourse, metaphysical inquiry, deep worldbuilding, philosophical fiction.

families.name: Reflective Trefoil
families.description: Large family (24 variants, 189‑212). Core‑centric with strong x→z but lighter peripheral connections.
families.best_for: Character studies, memoirs, contemplative fiction, balanced reflective narratives.

families.name: Intimate Trefoil
families.description: Small family (4 variants, 213‑216). Invariant core: 8→y, b→a, d→c, f→e.
families.best_for: Personal journeys, close relationships, interiority, intimate character‑focused narratives.

families.name: Transformative Trefoil
families.description: Large family (20 variants, 217‑236). Hierarchical merging from invariant skeleton to full connectivity.
families.best_for: Rebellion, evolution, paradigm shifts, revolutionary narratives, transformation stories.

families.name: Pure Trefoil
families.description: Small family (4 variants, 237‑240). Directed tree as 7‑node component.
families.best_for: Parables, fables, allegories, symbolic tales, pure‑form narratives.

families.name: Mirror Trefoil
families.description: Chiral pair (2 variants, 241‑242). Persistent skeleton with 2‑2‑4‑4‑7 decomposition.
families.best_for: Time‑travel stories, mirror‑worlds, duality, recursion, alternate timelines.

families.name: Hyperbolic Fig8
families.description: Hyperbolic family (3 variants, 243‑245). Persistent core: e→0.
families.best_for: Surreal fiction, dream‑logic, psychological horror, avant‑garde, weird fiction.

global.name: Global Aggregate
global.description: The complete aggregated adjacency over all 245 satellites.
global.best_for: Meta‑narratives, systems where all possible connections coexist, or when the precise stratum is deliberately unspecified.

usepong.constraint: Any Factor’s adjacency must be realizable as a satellite of T(19,2) or as a link/braid derived from it.

dynamics.role: State Transition Logic Derived from Knot Crossings and Resonance

definition.type: Ternary Logic Derived from Knot Crossings

resonance_embedding.phase_quantization: Phase is quantized in units of π/19 (38th roots of unity).

operations.reidemeister_1: Self‑interaction: adds/removes a full phase cycle (2π), preserving chirality.
operations.reidemeister_2: Pair interaction: cancels or creates opposite phases.
operations.reidemeister_3: Three‑way interaction: shifts phase by ±2π/3, can flip chirality.

constraint.phase_closure: Around any closed cycle, the sum of phase changes must be 0 mod 2π.
constraint.state_conservation: Sum of states around any closed cycle = 0 mod 3.
